guards.what: EV-3: Leave's `base.Rng.NextItem(Deck.Cards.Where(IsUpgraded))` (WelcomeToWongos.cs:158) -- events/welcome_to_wongos.py:90 uses self.rng.choice, so this event's single random draw rolls on the sim's shared run RNG (`self.rng`) where C# rolls on the per-event `base.Rng`
guards.issue: MECHANISM EV-3, one verdict at every site (rule 3). Each C# EventModel gets its own Rng seeded from the run seed + event id, and the sim already models it: Event.__init__ builds `self.event_rng` from make_event_rng(seed, ID) for string-seeded runs (events/base.py:84-88), and 6 modules branch on it. EXECUTED (`py tools/audit/event_probes.py eventrng`): 28 of the 34 event modules that roll anything roll ONLY on `self.rng`. LIVE for the parity path that the conformance harness grades -- a shared-rng draw both takes a number the game never takes off that stream and fails to advance the event stream, desyncing the rest of the run. In legacy (RL) mode both are the same random.Random, so the observable is parity-only -- which is an exercised sim mode, not an unreachable one.

guards.what: EV-11: BARGAIN_BIN's Common pull (WelcomeToWongos.cs:136) and GenerateInitialOptions' Rare pull (:80) calls run.pull_relic_from_front (run.py:559-595), which scans the merged bag for the first relic of the asked rarity passing the filter and, on no match, pops the FRONT OF THE BAG at any rarity. The game's RelicGrabBag.GetAvailableDeque (RelicGrabBag.cs:218-243) instead walks a rarity LADDER (Shop -> Common -> Uncommon -> Rare -> None) and RelicFactory.PullNextRelicFromFront falls back to `FallbackRelic` = Circlet (RelicFactory.cs:13, :47)
guards.issue: MECHANISM EV-11, one verdict at every pull_relic_from_front site (rule 3). Neither leg costs an RNG draw -- WelcomeToWongos uses the THREE-argument overload (RelicFactory.cs:45-50), which skips RollRarity entirely -- so this is purely WHICH relic comes out. EXECUTED (`py tools/audit/event_probes_c.py grabbag`): with the Common deque emptied, BARGAIN_BIN's `pull_relic_from_front(COMMON, shop_legal=True)` hands out 'gremlin_horn', an UNCOMMON, without walking the ladder; with no Rare left, FEATURED_ITEM hands out 'gremlin_horn' where the game hands out Circlet, and `circlet` is not even ported (`circlet in ALL_RELICS` is False). DORMANT: the probe shows the parity bag holds 122 relics with 36 Rare + IsAllowedInShops, and nothing in ported content drains a whole rarity deque inside one run -- the concrete unported thing that would make it live is the Circlet relic itself, plus any content that empties a deque. Recorded so the sim's bag-front fallback is not mistaken for the source's shape. RADIUS beyond this record: every other pull_relic_from_front caller -- events/luminous_choir.py, events/round_tea_party.py, events/relic_trader.py, relics/wongos_mystery_ticket.py:47 -- whose records verdicted the pull faithful on the STREAM question without examining the ladder.

guards.what: CheckObtainWongoBadge (WelcomeToWongos.cs:111-131) is not ported: the sim never grants WongoCustomerAppreciationBadge, and it tracks points on an ad-hoc attribute instead of run state
guards.issue: The badge is awarded when `SaveManager.Instance.Progress.WongoPoints % 2000 + pointsEarned >= 2000` (:113-123), i.e. off a PROFILE-lifetime counter -- the same shape as Test Subject's #C71. EXECUTED (`py tools/audit/event_probes_c.py wongo`): the relic IS ported (relics/wongo_customer_appreciation_badge.py) at rarity EVENT so it is not in the grab bag, there are ZERO `add_relic('wongo_customer...')` sites in the sim's event, and `wongo_points` appears in no sts2_rl file other than welcome_to_wongos.py -- it is created by `getattr(run, 'wongo_points', 0)` at events/welcome_to_wongos.py:63 rather than being RunState state. DORMANT, with the concrete unported thing named: there is no port of SaveManager.Progress (cross-run profile progression) at all, so a fresh sim profile can never reach 2000 -- but a real profile sitting at 1968+ points earns the badge on the very next purchase, which is why this is a dormant gap and not a waiver (rule 1). Two secondary notes, both executed by the same probe: (a) the relic's own docstring claims 'A single run can earn at most 32+16+8 = 56 points' -- false, because each of the three buy handlers ends in SetEventFinished / _finish (count = 3) and the event is act-2-only and once-per-run, so the true maximum is 32; (b) the game SETS `Owner.ExtraFields.WongoPoints = pointsEarned` (:120) where the sim ACCUMULATES, which coincides only because one purchase is possible per run.
